TAVILY_API_KEY.description: Tavily search API credential used by the octocode-brainstorming skill.

EXA_API_KEY.description: Exa search API credential used by the octocode-brainstorming skill.

SERPER_API_KEY.description: Serper search API credential used by the octocode-brainstorming skill.

TAVILY_BASE_URL.description: Tavily API root; receives TAVILY_API_KEY. Home-only, so a repository cannot redirect your key.

EXA_BASE_URL.description: Exa API root; receives EXA_API_KEY. Home-only, so a repository cannot redirect your key.

SERPER_BASE_URL.description: Serper API root; receives SERPER_API_KEY. Home-only, so a repository cannot redirect your key.

SCRAPING_ANT.description: ScrapingAnt API credential used by the octocode-scraping skill.

HTTPS_PROXY.description: Proxy for HTTPS requests and clone git. Shell, CI or MCP env block only.

HTTP_PROXY.description: Proxy for HTTP requests and clone git. Shell, CI or MCP env block only.

ALL_PROXY.description: Proxy for every protocol. Shell, CI or MCP env block only.

NO_PROXY.description: Hosts that skip the proxy. Shell, CI or MCP env block only.

SSL_CERT_FILE.description: Extra PEM certificates for native HTTP clients and clone git. Shell, CI or MCP env block only.

SSL_CERT_DIR.description: Directories of extra PEM certificates. Shell, CI or MCP env block only.

GIT_SSL_CAINFO.description: CA bundle for clone git. Shell, CI or MCP env block only.

GIT_SSL_CAPATH.description: CA directory for clone git. Shell, CI or MCP env block only.

CURL_CA_BUNDLE.description: CA bundle for clone git. Shell, CI or MCP env block only.

OCTOCODE_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: GitHub OAuth client override, for GitHub Enterprise.

OCTOCODE_CARGO.description: Override the cargo executable used for Rust dependency-graph analysis.

apiUrl.description: GitHub REST API root. GitHub Enterprise commonly uses /api/v3.

enabled.description: Expose local filesystem tools through MCP. CLI tools remain available; path and content security apply on both surfaces.

beta.description: Expose graphBuild and graphQuery through MCP. CLI tools remain available without this opt-in. Restart MCP after changing this setting.

allowedPaths.description: Extra absolute or home-relative roots added to the allowed roots (workspace root and OCTOCODE_HOME).
allowedPaths.notes: The environment value is a comma-separated list.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional absolute or home-relative workspace root.

enabled.description: Strict MCP tool allowlist; other MCP prerequisites still apply. CLI exposes every tool in the build.

disabled.description: Tools removed from MCP discovery and admission. CLI exposes every tool in the build.

enableClone.description: Expose ghCloneRepo through MCP. CLI remains available. Clone execution requires persistent storage on both surfaces. Restart MCP after changing this setting.

allowPrivateRegistry.description: Allow private, loopback, or link-local artifact registries.
allowPrivateRegistry.notes: Security-sensitive SSRF escape hatch; opt in only for trusted enterprise registries.

autoInstall.description: Whether `octocode lsp-server install` may download a managed language server: prompt (ask), off, or auto.

trustProjectConfig.description: Trust a project .octocode/lsp-servers.json. Security-sensitive: a trusted project config can launch server binaries.

prewarm.description: Language-server prewarm: targeted starts the server an offered lspSearch call names once the session has run an lspSearch; all warms it from the start, also warms the file a read or search names and, at MCP initialize, the workspace's top three languages; off disables it. Each start indexes a whole project, so a first lspSearch under targeted can take seconds in exchange for no server in a session that never calls one.

redactEmails.description: Mask email addresses such as GitHub commit authors.

mode.description: Persistent saves continuation state and provider answers to disk; memory retains them only in the current runtime. Fresh local requests recompute results; GitHub and registry answers repeat as their origin allows. Explicit graph snapshots are outputs; interrupted extraction checkpoints follow this setting.

api.description: Classification provider API key. A nonblank value exposes clasify and read-tool classifiers in MCP; CLI always exposes clasify and checks the key when invoked. Discovery makes no provider request.
api.notes: Credential values are omitted from resolved configuration and diagnostics.

apiHost.description: Classification provider API root, for a proxy, gateway or compatible provider that serves the same API.
apiHost.notes: Calls require HTTPS except on loopback, and an API root with no path. Home-only, so a repository cannot redirect your key.

model.description: Classification model for read-tool classifiers and clasify; a clasify row's model overrides it.
model.notes: Pin an exact model (for example jev-1.13.0) for reproducible results; an alias can change between fresh evaluations.
